neighbours.label: The body's handling of sugar and fluids in diabetes / dehydration text: 'use' in 'the body cannot use sugar/insulin', and thirst or electrolytes as a bodily deficit
fire: In type 1 diabetes the pancreas makes no insulin, so the body is unable to use glucose from food.
When cells stop responding to insulin, muscles can no longer use sugar from the bloodstream properly.
Diabetes is a condition in which a person's body cannot make or properly use insulin to control blood sugar.
Because her body could not use the sugar in her blood, she felt weak and tired all day.
Doctors explained that his body had lost much of its ability to use insulin and store glucose.
The most common warning of high blood sugar is intense thirst, followed by frequent urination and blurred vision.
If you are dehydrated you will notice thirst, followed by a dry mouth and a pounding headache.
Insulin is the hormone that lets the body's cells take in and use sugar for energy.
quiet: The old generator was unable to use the cheaper fuel from the depot, so it sat idle.
When workers stop responding to emails, managers can no longer use the schedule from the planning office properly.
Asthma is a condition in which a person's airways narrow and swell, making it hard to breathe.
Because her car could not climb the hill in the snow, she felt stuck and late all day.
Doctors explained that his knee had lost much of its range of motion after the surgery.
The most common warning of a migraine is flashing lights, followed by nausea and a throbbing pain.
If you are overtired you will notice yawning, followed by poor focus and a short temper.
A thermostat is the device that lets the heating system switch on and off at set temperatures.

notes: Card: ' use' (ability to use sugar/insulin), ' thirst', ' electroly'. Probes: 'cannot use sugar for energy' 0.58, 'ability to use insulin' 0.49, 'thirst, followed by' 0.47; 'cannot use diesel for fuel' 0.02, 'lost the ability to walk' 0.00. The + pole is supply/availability (hot water supply, enough saliva), so this pole may be the need side of that distinction. A code 'true value' example on the card is not covered.
